name: Bars Scale Wave
description: Five vertical bars scale in height with staggered timing to create a wave equalizer effect

variations.name: default
variations.description: Vertical bars grow and shrink in a wave pattern with staggered delays, resembling an audio equalizer

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the loader container in pixels

props.name: barWidth
props.description: Width of each bar in pixels

props.name: isAnimating
props.description: Controls whether the animation runs. Set to false to pause animation.
